all 2500 size-two through size-four subset candidates

screen and exact objective order plus deterministic tie-breaks

known_evidence_boundary: The target-aware designer may optimize exact relations only on 128 frozen train representatives. Validation is reserved from computation but not historically unknowable, and the v0 test block is explicitly consumed. No later learner may call either surface blind.
optimization_boundary: The cheap screen is exhaustive over 2500 frozen candidates; relation scoring is exact only for the frozen 96-candidate shortlist and does not establish a global relation optimum.
change_policy: Changing any manifest, fixture selection, candidate size, shortlist width, objective order, tie-break, gate, phase boundary, or baseline requires a new sim version.
